candidates.change_summary: Move zeroing of the caller's balance to before the external call (prevents reentrancy altering balances at other keys).
Remove the external call result check so failed sends do not revert and balances are still cleared, changing post-withdraw balances observable after completion.
Clear a different account's balance (address(0)) instead of the caller's, altering balances at key k after withdraw.
Remove the reentrancy lock (do not set __lock_modifier0_lock), allowing reentrant calls to mutate balances during withdraw and potentially change balances at other keys.
Move the balances reset to before the external call so balance is zeroed prior to sending funds (prevents reentrant drain and changes post-withdraw balance observable).
Remove the lock modifier from withdraw so reentrancy protection is gone, which can alter final balances after withdraw completes.
Zero the balance before requiring successful external send; if send fails the balance remains zero — changes post-withdraw state when send reverts differently handled.
